name: Beaconsfield Mine & Heritage Centre
coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node tourism=museum 'Beaconsfield Mine & Heritage Centre' (Wikipedia article point is 140 m away, Commons median 190 m)
ticketUrl_note: Operator site; heading names the centre. Adult $25 (concession $19, child 5-16 $10, under 5 free).
bio: Gold-mine museum with hands-on exhibits and the story of the 2006 rescue of two trapped miners.
unverified: Closed Christmas Day, Good Friday and until noon ANZAC Day (operator page); not a weekly closure

name: Low Head Lighthouse
coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node man_made=lighthouse 'Low Head Lighthouse' (the Wikipedia point is 570 m north)
hours: Grounds open daily (daytime); museum open daily; foghorn Sunday noon
ticketUrl_note: Parks and Wildlife Service page, heading 'Low Head Historic Site'. Operator of the museum is lowheadpilotstation.com (200) as alternative.
bio: Light station at the Tamar mouth, third in Australia, with a pilot station museum and a Sunday noon foghorn.
unverified: Exact museum/grounds hours not on the Parks page (says museum open daily); no entry fee stated on the Parks page, so free:true (museum run by volunteers, donation per search result not confirmed on operator page)

Cafe, accommodation and toilets at the Pilot Station closed from 22 Apr 2026 until a new lessee; Cottage 2 site closed to the public until about Nov 2026 (Parks alert reviewed 30/9/2026); museum and grounds remain open

name: Platypus House
coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way building=yes tourism=attraction 'Platypus House' (centroid); placement point 6 m away
ticketUrl_note: Operator site, title 'Platypus House'. Adult $31.50 (concession $29.50, child 4-16 $14.50).
bio: Guided tour through ponds and gardens to watch live platypus and echidnas feeding by day at Beauty Point.
unverified: Hours are the Feb-Dec 18 season (Dec 19-Jan 31: 9:30 AM-4:30 PM, last tour 4:00 PM); closed Christmas Day only; site says bookings are essential

name: Seahorse World
coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap way building=yes tourism=attraction 'Seahorse World' (centroid); placement point 12 m away
hours: Tours hourly 10:00 AM – 3:00 PM (May–Nov); 9:30 AM – 4:00 PM (Dec–Apr)
ticketUrl_note: Operator site, title 'Seahorse World | Tasmania'. Adult $28.90 (seniors/students $25.90, child 4-16 $13.90).
bio: Working seahorse farm at Beauty Point with a 50-minute guided tour that ends holding a seahorse.
unverified: Open and trading (Wikivoyage's dead link is stale); closed Christmas Day; 4 PM tours only if booked in advance. Some sub-pages (e.g. /plan-your-visit/opening-hours/) return a CleanTalk 403 to scripts but the homepage, plan-your-visit and tickets pages loaded.

name: Bass and Flinders Centre
coordinates_source: Operator's own map on bassandflindersmuseum.com.au/contact (marker titled '8 Elizabeth Street, George Town'); agrees with the Wikivoyage listing point within 35 m. No OSM feature for the museum.
ticketUrl_note: Operator site; domain is bassandflindersmuseum.com.au (bassandflinders.com.au is a 'launching soon' page - not used).
bio: George Town maritime museum with a replica of the sloop Norfolk that Bass and Flinders sailed up the Tamar in 1798.
unverified: The operator's own pages disagree: /visit-us says 11 AM-3 PM daily and adult $13; /book-now says 10 AM-4 PM (11 AM start Sun/Wed) and adult $14. Used the /visit-us figures
The operator now calls it the Bass and Flinders Maritime Museum (input name kept)
Admission includes a guided tour; also open by appointment on (03) 6382 3792

unverified: Hours are not given by any source; entry charge not stated (free assumed: no gate or fee mentioned)

name: Eddystone Point Lighthouse
coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node man_made=lighthouse 'Eddystone Point Lighthouse' (Wikipedia point of the cape is 130 m away)
hours: Grounds open daylight hours; lighthouse and cottages by arrangement only
ticketUrl_note: Managing agency's Mount William National Park page, which covers the point.
bio: Pink-granite lighthouse, opened in 1889, on the point at the northern end of the Bay of Fires.
unverified: Parks pass cost applies because the point sits inside Mount William National Park (Parks page); no separate Eddystone Point page on parks.tas.gov.au (404)
A tourism listing says the lighthouse interior and cottages are open only by arrangement with the traditional owners (not confirmed by the agency); grounds hours unverified

name: Mount William National Park
coordinates_source: Midpoint of OSM way highway=unclassified 'Forester Kangaroo Drive' (the park's main drive, 1.5 km); Parks page gives no point. Placement was the park-wide Wikipedia centroid.
bio: Remote northeast national park of white beaches, orange-lichen rocks and heath where forester kangaroos graze.
unverified: Pin is a visitor-area judgement (OSM road inside the park), not an agency-given point
Entry is a parks pass: $49.15 per vehicle per day, $24.55 per person on foot/bus/bike (PASS page, fee reviewed annually)
Unsealed access roads from Gladstone, about 17 km

name: Mount William (wukalina) Summit Walk
coordinates_source: Midpoint of OSM way highway=path 'Mount William Summit Track' (1.75 km one way, ends on peak node 'Wukalina / Mount William')
ticketUrl_note: Managing agency page for the park; the Parks page describes this walk.
bio: A 90-minute return walk on a defined track to the 216 m summit, with views to the Furneaux Islands on clear days.
unverified: Walk is inside Mount William National Park: parks pass $49.15 per vehicle per day
The OSM way named 'Mount William Summit Walk' (531 m, near Stumpys Bay) is a different short path and was not used

name: St Columba Falls
coordinates_source: OpenStreetMap node waterway=waterfall tourism=attraction 'St Columba Falls' (the falls; viewing platform is at its base)
bio: Falls dropping almost 90 m, reached by a 20–30 minute return forest walk from the road near Pyengana.
unverified: State reserve page states no parks-pass requirement (only national parks do), so free:true; not stated outright as free
